This is accelerated approval on a hemoglobin-response surrogate after RISE UP missed on annualized pain-crisis rate (the November 2025 miss that spawned the Levi & Korsinsky / Pomerantz / Gross securities investigations still running), and FDA's confidence in Hb response as an SCD surrogate was damaged by the 2024 global withdrawal of Oxbryta, the prior Hb-surrogate accelerated approval in this exact indication. Tebapivat's Phase 2 failure is also not purely noise — Agios' own language, that response rates were "consistent with the class" but not differentiated, is a mild negative datapoint on PK-activator effect size, even though the discontinuation was a portfolio decision rather than a safety or mechanism failure.

The one genuinely differentiated wrinkle is that the Form 10 makes Vylor the continuing registrant with New Corteva presented as discontinued operations, an inversion that changes which entity keeps index membership and therefore which side sees the forced-seller flow — real, but too small to size and not a G3 figure. Real event, clean cap structure, no valuation gap: score the equity, WATCH not ACTIVE.
